translations.web: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths; and every basin was four cubits; and on every one of the ten bases one basin.
translations.bsb: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
translations.kjv: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
translations.asv: And he made ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths; and every laver was four cubits; and upon very one of the ten bases one laver.
